title: anacyclus pyrethrum var. depressus
intro: Anacyclus pyrethrum var. depressus, commonly known as Dwarf Anacyclus, is a perennial plant in the daisy family, characterized by its small flowers and woody stems. The health benefits of Dwarf Anacyclus include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive issues, and soothe oral and gum infections due to its antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and carminative properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Anacyclus include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
